bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health | grep -q '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS$'
if output="$(python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py bot_start_menu 2>&1)"; then
 status=PASS
else status=FAIL
fi
active="$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)"
health="$(python3 scripts/userbot_test_client.py health 2>&1 || true)"
image="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
{ echo 'PR47_POSTDEPLOY_BOT_REGRESSION'; echo "START_MENU_RESULT=$status"; printf '%s\n' "$output" | grep -E '^(USERBOT_TEST_RESULT|USERBOT_TEST_MENU_ROWS|USERBOT_TEST_STEPS|USERBOT_TEST_ERROR)=' || true; echo "USERBOT_ACTIVE=$active"; printf '%s\n' "$health" | grep -E '^USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=' || true; echo "GAYBBS_IMAGE=$image"; echo "GAYBBS_RUNNING=$running"; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
